fem.text: On Sarpadia, the climate cooled after the Golgothian Sylex was activated, crops failed, and strife broke out between former allies.
The dwarven kingdom fell to a chaos-driven army of orcs and goblins, and then the Ebon Hand fell to the thrulls and the elves to the thallids.
Icatia, weakened by the Farrelite Cult, finally fell to orcs, goblins, thrulls and thallids aided by Tevesh Szat, the last of the Sarpadian empires to fall.
In the end the thrulls destroyed the goblins and the last of the orcs, and kept evolving, content with their isolation.
